hints.title: Computing Unit Volume
hints.text: The volume of a single product unit is calculated by multiplying Width, Length, and Height.

hints.title: Joining Warehouses with Products
hints.text: join Warehouse with Products on product_id to associate inventory count with dimensions.

hints.title: Aggregating Total Warehouse Footprint
hints.text: group by warehouse name and calculate sum(units * Width * Length * Height) as volume.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT w.name AS warehouse_name,
       SUM(w.units * p.Width * p.Length * p.Height) AS volume
FROM Warehouse w
JOIN Products p ON w.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY w.name;
```

complexity.notes: Executes hash join between warehouse inventories and product specifications before summing volumes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Neglecting to multiply unit counts by 3-dimensional volume yields product counts instead of physical cubic footprint.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct product dimension arithmetic computes volumetric aggregates in a single aggregation step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Join and volumetric arithmetic expression inside sum aggregate grouped by warehouse.
